chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Malik ibn Atiyya, from Durays al-Kunasi, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) passed by a man planting a sapling in a wall of his. So he paused for him and said: 'Shall I indicate to you a plant whose roots are firm, whose growth is quick, whose fruit is sweet, and which remains (forever)?' He said, 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah!'

So he said: 'When it is morning and evening, say: 'Glory be to Allah, and the Praise is for Allah, and there is no God except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest'. For you, if you say it, for every glorification, there will be ten trees in Paradise from various kinds of fruit, and these are from the righteous enduring good deeds.'
He said: So the man said, 'So I testify, O Messenger of Allah, that this wall of mine is a charity, held in possession, for the poor Muslims, the people of charity.'
So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed verses from the Quran: 'Then as for him who gives away and fears [God] and accepts the best, We will facilitate for him the easy end.'

key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: There is no God except Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting the morning and evening glorification of Allah according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the spiritual efficacy of the morning and evening Tasbih, linking the physical act of planting with the eternal reward of 'Al-Baqiyat al-Salihat' (the enduring good deeds). The man’s immediate declaration of his wall as charity (Sadaqah) upon hearing the promise illustrates the transformative power of dhikr, which the text explicitly connects to the revelation of Surah Ash-Sharh (92:5-7) regarding those who give and are pious.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Malik Bin Atiyya, from Zureys Al Kunasy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> passed by a man planting a plant in a wall of his. So he<sup>saww</sup> paused for him and said: ‘Shall I<sup>saww</sup> indicate to you upon a plant whose roots are firm, and its growth is quick, and its fruits are good, and it would remain (forever)?’ He said, ‘Yes, O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>!’.

So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Whenever it is morning and evening, so say, ‘Glory be to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and the Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and there is no God except for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is the Greatest’, so for you would be for every Glorification, if you were to say it, ten trees in the Paradise from a variety of fruits, and these would be from the righteous good deeds’.

He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘So the man said, ‘So I testify, O Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup>, that his wall of mine is a charity held upon for the poor Muslims, the ones deserving of the charity’.
So Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Revealed Verses from the Quran [92:5] Then as for him who gives away and fears [92:6] And accepts the best, [92:7] We will facilitate for him the easy end’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ibn Mahbub from Malik ibn ‘Atiyyah from Durays al-Kunasi from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:

“The Messenger of Allah once was passing by a man who was planting a plant in his yard. The Holy Prophet stopped and asked, ‘Should I tell you about a plantation that has stronger roots, ripens faster and is of finer fruits?’ The man said, ‘Yes, O Messenger of Allah, tell me about it.’

The Messenger of Allah said, ‘In the morning and evenings say, “Glory belongs to Allah, all praise belongs to Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is greater than can be described.” If you say this, for each time you will have ten trees in paradise of different kinds of fruits. They are (the reward) from perpetually charitable trusts.’
The Imam said that the man then said, ‘I take Allah as witness that my yard is a charitable trust and the needy Muslims are its beneficiaries.’

Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, then revealed the verses of the Holy Quran: ‘For those who spend for the cause of Allah, observe piety, [92:5] and believe in receiving rewards from Allah, [92:6] We shall facilitate the path to bliss’” [92:7]
